requirements: Creativity, verbal and written communication skills and problem solving ability are required.
Strong leadership and mentoring skills necessary to provide support and constructive performance feedback.
Strong ability to utilize various forms of media, including print, electronic and film.
Strong ability to visualize in 2D and 3D and understand aesthetic aspects of design.
Previous experience using the computer to create layouts and generate new images.
Experience with Adobe publishing and graphics software a plus.
responsibilities: Instruct and lead other designers in the planning, analyzing and creation of visual solutions to communication problems.
Approve and review overall layout and production design of publications or web interfaces as they relate to graphic design, and suggest improvements as needed.
Review prepared sketches or layouts of other designers to present to client.
Review and approve charts and graphs created by other designers from data given.

estimate.method: Interquartile range of disclosed pay on 16 remote motion-design postings in this dataset (any region, converted to INR today). Employer-specific pay is unknown, and employer-of-record or location-based pay policies often lower offers for India-based hires.

Summary:
 The main function of a graphic designer is to create designs, concepts and sample layouts based on design principles and concepts. A typical graphic designer needs to have a high level of creativity and able to communicate their ideas to both internal and external clients. The ability to be flexible to client demands, work well under pressure and multi-task are required skills.
